anchors.quote: The system of controls is effective for the type of export operations and activities conducted at the establishment.

notes: The two PRIMARY_NORM candidates (rules2021:4-3(3) and rules2021:3-1(3)) are parallel provisions for different facility types (registered establishments vs accredited properties). They jointly ground a single holistic proposition about the effectiveness of the system of controls, as indicated by the validated RuleSetRelation SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION. No ALL/ANY structure is created because the CP does not explicitly require separate satisfaction for each facility type, and the rules do not indicate cumulative or alternative application.
All other candidates are contract_eligible == false and are therefore excluded from basis_candidate_ids. They may provide context but do not independently ground the satisfaction atom.
